title: version
summary: Return RunMat version and MATLAB-compatibility release metadata.
description: `version` returns the RunMat crate version. `version('-release')` returns RunMat's advertised MATLAB compatibility release string.
behaviors: No arguments returns the RunMat package version.
`'-release'` returns the centrally configured compatibility release for branching.
`'-java'` returns an empty string because RunMat does not embed MATLAB's Java runtime.

faqs.question: Is this MATLAB's exact version?
faqs.answer: No. It reports RunMat's runtime version plus a MATLAB compatibility release for common branching code.
